issue.title: Post-provider update-skew deaths: resume in place instead of notify-only

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a resume-in-place recovery mode for agents that die from update skew after their model turn: reuse the held workspace and finish finalization instead of only notifying (proposed by sase-1j6.9, epic sase-1j6).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1j6 settled that post-provider deaths are notify-only (notify_post_provider) and named resume-in-place as a follow-up.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1j6.9 (land phase of epic sase-1j6): post-provider skew deaths are notify-only today, leaving a held workspace the user must relaunch by hand.

payload.description: Both reshape update-skew recovery; pinning removes Tier 1-2 skew
Check related finalizer-resume bead cited by cld report
Once classified as skew, these post-provider deaths need sase-1jf's resume-in-place recovery to finish carried work

evidence.note: Three post-provider update-skew deaths on 2026-11-03 10:56-10:58 (sase update ff to ced5901dd5) stranded real work. 17a--3's commit finalizer had already carried 13 dirty bob-mac-capture files to its staged monitor (finalizer_result carried_repo). The successor never launched, so the files are still uncommitted in workspace bob-cli_15. sase-1n6.11.1 had closed its bead, then died; its sase-core release_steward edits were evicted into ~/.sase/rescue/202611/20261103T214433Z-ws11-linked-sase-core-234c21fc at a manual relaunch 6h later. Resume-in-place would have finished both. Note: none of the three were even notified as skew, because TypeError signature skew fails the prefilter (sase-1r4).
